title: T09 — Run the 28 new expanded-pack cases on the authorized Gemma profile
goal: First run of general-assistant-expanded@1.0.0 (Gauntlet 0.5.0), never run in NERV, under the same authorized bounded profile as the first smoke
acceptance: Owner approves the budget; the plan from gauntlet:all shows the 28 expanded cases as new and the 10 smoke cases as reused (or stale)
Saved private report; a summary in docs/evaluations with pass/fail per case, telemetry gaps explicit and no qualification claim
The T07 ledger records the run, and check:gauntlet-runs reports no pending cases
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Report admitted by the pinned Gauntlet release; summary numbers match the report
escalation: Owner action: approve and start the real-model campaign (first smoke: 10 cases in about 65 s, so 28 cases are expected in a few minutes)

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement.
